summary: An Abu Dhabi dental clinic open since 1992 appears to lose new patients to a free builder address, a 2020 date and a hotmail contact.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page.
findings.cost: Patients check a clinic's credibility online first, and a free builder address looks temporary for a clinic trading since 1992.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clinic email.

findings.problem: The page appears to carry a 2020 copyright date.
findings.cost: An old date tells a patient the clinic may not be active, so they book a competitor.

findings.problem: The contact appears to be a hotmail address.
findings.cost: A free email gives less trust, and it can land in spam when patients and insurers write to you.
findings.fix: A clinic email on your own domain.

redesign: Fresh look with doctors and insurance.
